item.title: Australian Business SEO Referral Partners
item.description:

We're looking for freelancers and independent professionals who know Australian business owners.
Do you work with small businesses, entrepreneurs or sole traders? Perhaps you're a website designer, developer, graphic designer, virtual assistant, consultant or freelancer who regularly comes into contact with business owners.
LabRank Digital is looking to establish relationships with people who can introduce us to Australian businesses that could benefit from professional SEO services.
Here's how it works:
You identify an Australian business that could benefit from better visibility in Google.
With the business owner's permission, you introduce them to LabRank Digital.
We take care of everything from there, including the consultation, SEO recommendations, follow-up and customer onboarding.
If your introduction becomes a paying customer, you receive an agreed referral payment.
What makes this opportunity different?
No selling required.
No SEO experience necessary.
No customer management.
No quotas or minimum referrals.
Work from anywhere.
Refer businesses whenever an opportunity arises.
Earn additional income from connections you already have.
Who can apply?
We welcome applications from:
Freelance website designers and developers.
Graphic designers.
Digital marketing freelancers.
Social media managers.
Virtual assistants.
Business consultants and coaches.
Independent professionals with Australian business contacts.
IMPORTANT LOCATION REQUIREMENT
This opportunity is primarily open to freelancers based in Australia.
We will also consider applicants based overseas, provided they have genuine existing connections with Australian small businesses and can introduce us to Australian business owners.
Having Australian business connections is essential, regardless of where you are located.
About LabRank Digital
LabRank Digital provides affordable SEO services to Australian small businesses and sole traders. Our services include on-page SEO, ongoing SEO and Local SEO, with straightforward pricing and no long-term contracts.
How do you get paid?
This is a performance-based referral partnership.
You receive an agreed referral payment when a business you introduce becomes a paying LabRank customer and their payment has cleared.
Referral payments are processed through the agreed Freelancer milestone arrangement, subject to Freelancer's platform rules and our referral agreement.
Full referral rates, attribution requirements and payment terms are provided before participation.
This is not a traditional sales position.
We're looking for people who already have relationships with Australian businesses and would like to generate additional income by making introductions.
If you know Australian business owners, we'd like to hear from you.
Apply with a brief introduction explaining your professional background and the types of Australian businesses or business owners you regularly interact with. Also, in your reply, state the word "Organic" to show me that you have read this brief to the end and understand whats on offer.

item.title: Sourdough Bakery Site
item.description:
30-250 USD | Website Design & Development for Artisan Sourdough Bakery
Project: Sourdough Clouds Bakery — Grass Valley, California
We are looking for a creative, experienced web designer/developer to build a beautiful, professional, mobile-friendly website for our artisan sourdough bakery.
We want something unique, warm, inviting, and easy to navigate — not a generic bakery template.
Our bakery specializes in naturally fermented artisan sourdough bread, specialty loaves, focaccia, challah, cookies, and other baked goods.
1. Website Concept & Design
Our website should be inspired by the journey of sourdough bread, from a living starter to a finished loaf.
We have an existing watercolor-style illustration showing the stages of sourdough bread making. We want to use this illustration as inspiration for the website's overall design, colors, graphics, and navigation.
The design should feel:
- Artisan, handcrafted, warm, and welcoming - Natural, rustic, and elegant - Inspired by watercolor illustrations, wheat, flour, dough, and freshly baked bread - Professional, clean, and easy to navigate - Beautiful on both desktop and mobile devices
We do not want complicated animations or a website that forces visitors through the bread-making process. Customers should be able to navigate directly to any section.
2. Unique Website Navigation — Very Important
Instead of traditional navigation buttons such as "About Us," "Our Story," and "Products," we want the main navigation to follow the stages of sourdough bread making.
Proposed navigation:
STARTER → MIX → RISE → BAKE → ENJOY
Each navigation button represents a regular website section:
STARTER — Our Story
- Introduction to Sourdough Clouds Bakery - Who we are and how our bakery began - Our passion for traditional sourdough baking - Our values and philosophy
MIX — Our Bakery & Ingredients
- What makes our bakery special - Our approach to quality ingredients - Naturally fermented sourdough - Simple ingredients and traditional baking methods - Information about our bakery and what we offer
RISE — Our Process
- A dedicated page explaining our complete sourdough-making process - Mixing, folding, bulk fermentation, shaping, overnight cold fermentation, scoring, baking, and cooling - Illustrations and photographs showing the different stages - Explaining why our bread takes time and what makes the process special
BAKE — Our Bread & Cookies
- Full product menu with beautiful photographs - Traditional artisan sourdough loaves - Specialty savory and sweet sourdough - Sandwich loaves - Focaccia - Challah - Cookies and other bakery products - Product descriptions, prices, and available options
ENJOY — Visit & Contact
- Bakery location and address - Opening hours - Google Maps integration - Contact information - Social media links - Information about ordering and pickup
We would like small illustrations or design elements connecting each navigation section to its corresponding stage of bread making.
The navigation should be creative but intuitive, with clear subtitles or descriptions when necessary.
3. Online Ordering System
This is an important part of the website.
Customers should be able to:
- Browse our bakery products with photos and prices - Select products and quantities - Choose available bread varieties and flavors - Customize certain products with optional ingredients/add-ons and additional charges - Add multiple products to a shopping cart - Choose an available pickup date/time - Enter their contact information - Submit orders and receive an order confirmation
We would prefer online payment capability through a secure payment provider, such as Stripe or Square, with the possibility of enabling payment at pickup.
The bakery owner must be able to:
- Add, edit, or remove products - Update prices and product descriptions - Add new seasonal flavors - Change product availability - Manage pickup dates and ordering deadlines - Receive and manage customer orders - Mark products as sold out
The ordering system should be straightforward and easy for customers to use.
4. Additional Website Requirements
- Fully responsive design for mobile, tablet, and desktop - Fast loading and good performance - Basic search engine optimization (SEO) - Google Maps integration - Instagram and Facebook links - Contact form - Easy-to-use administration dashboard - Secure website with SSL - Ability to update text, photographs, products, and prices without programming knowledge - Basic training or instructions for managing the website - All website administrator credentials and ownership transferred to us upon completion
5. Platform & Development
We are open to WordPress/WooCommerce or another affordable, reliable platform.
We prefer a solution that:
- Is inexpensive to maintain - Does not require a developer for everyday updates - Can grow with our bakery - Avoids unnecessary monthly subscriptions - Uses existing reliable tools/plugins where appropriate rather than expensive custom programming
We can provide our logo, existing artwork, bakery information, and product photographs.
6. What We Expect From the Developer
Please include the following in your proposal:
1. Your total fixed price for the complete website. 2. Examples of similar websites you have built, especially bakery, restaurant, or e-commerce websites. 3. Which platform you recommend and why. 4. Whether the online ordering system is included in your quote. 5. Estimated completion time. 6. Number of design revisions included. 7. Any additional costs, including plugins, hosting, or subscriptions. 8. Whether you provide support after launch.
We are looking for a creative, affordable developer who can bring our concept to life while keeping the website simple to operate and maintain.
Our goal is a beautiful bakery website that tells our story, showcases our products, explains the care behind our sourdough, and makes ordering easy for our customers.

item.title: Travel Directory Website Growth & Monetization Specialist – SEO, Backlinks,Microsites, Scraping
item.description:
250-750 USD | ## HOW TO APPLY
We are looking for someone who can demonstrate real experience building and growing websites, preferably travel directories, business directories, marketplaces, or listing platforms.
**Please include the following information with your application:**
1. **Directory Websites Built:** Provide links to directory websites, travel platforms, marketplaces, or listing websites you have personally built or managed. We strongly prefer candidates with actual directory website development experience.
2. **Your Role:** Explain exactly what you were responsible for building, including website design, functionality, search features, business listings, subscriptions, and payment integration.
3. **Monthly Sales & Revenue:** For websites you have built or managed, please share: - Number of paying businesses or subscribers. - Average monthly subscription price. - Total monthly recurring revenue (MRR). - Total monthly website revenue, if applicable. - Number of businesses acquired through your efforts.
4. **Website Traffic:** Provide examples of organic traffic growth, Google rankings, and SEO results.
5. **Monetization Experience:** Explain how you generated revenue through paid listings, featured placements, advertising, affiliate commissions, or subscriptions.
6. **Proposed Platform:** Which platform would you recommend for building our travel directory and why?
7. **Monthly Compensation:** What monthly compensation would you expect for an ongoing, long-term working relationship?
8. **Your Growth Strategy:** Briefly explain how you would approach building the website and growing it into a profitable business over the next 6–12 months.
**IMPORTANT:** Please provide actual website links and measurable results wherever possible. If you share revenue figures, indicate whether they are verified, estimated, or confidential.
We are particularly interested in someone who has already built a directory website that generates recurring monthly revenue.
We are not looking for someone who simply installs a template. We want someone who can build the platform, continuously improve it, attract visitors, acquire paying businesses, and help grow the business long term.

item.title: TTRPG Podcast Site Rebuild

Acceptance criteria 1. Fully responsive build on a maintainable platform (WordPress, Webflow, or your suggested CMS). 2. Navigation that highlights Listen, Start a Campaign, Merch, and Characters as primary menu items. 3. Acceptance criteria 1. Above-the-fold messaging answers “what does UnifiedOrders do?” in plain English. 2. Primary CTAs (“Book a Demo”) are visible without feeling pushy. 3. Design elements are original or fully licensed—no stock-template look. 4. File structure in Figma is tidy and labeled for easy dev handover.
Start your proposal with the word “coconut” so I know you visited the current site and read this brief.

Zoomable galleries are a must. • Filters or selectors that let customers choose a package by three criteria at once: gym size, brand, and gym type. The selection flow has to feel seamless on both desktop and mobile.
I’ll supply the images, brand assets, and copy; you focus on page structure, styling, and any WooCommerce attribute or variation set-up required. All work must be done within my existing WordPress install using the Divi Theme Builder so I can keep everything consistent with the rest of the site.

https://gympros.com/commercial-treadmills/commercial-gym-packages/
Deliverables 1. Divi layout files (or saved layouts in the Library) for the main shop grid, individual package page, and each landing page. 2. Configured WooCommerce attributes/variations enabling the size-brand-type selection. 3. Responsive testing across modern browsers and standard mobile breakpoints. 4. A brief screen-share or loom walkthrough showing how to edit sections in Divi.
If this sounds straightforward to you and you’ve built similar WooCommerce product flows inside Divi, let’s talk timelines and any clarifications you need.

item.title: Boost Site Speed for SEO
item.description:
30-250 AUD | I need a specialist who can make every page on my site feel instantly responsive, with a clear focus on Google’s mobile metrics. The primary objective is to lift my Google search rankings, so I’m interested in tangible gains on Core Web Vitals and PageSpeed Insights for mobile users rather than just marginal desktop tweaks.
You’ll start with a performance audit, spot the bottlenecks that slow mobile loads, then apply best-practice fixes—asset compression, smart caching, code minification, image optimisation, server or CDN tuning, whatever is required—to lift scores across the board, not just the homepage.
Acceptance criteria • Baseline report showing current metrics for a representative set of pages • Updated configuration or code changes applied across the full site • Post-optimisation report demonstrating a mobile PageSpeed Insights score consistently hitting the “Good” range (90+) on those same pages • Clear hand-over notes so I can maintain the improvements
If you have proven results in site-wide speed optimisation for SEO gains, especially on mobile, I’m ready to get started right away.

item.title: CCBill Model Video Platform
item.description:
1500-3000 USD | I’m launching a subscription-and-pay-per-download video site where independent models can earn directly from their content. Members must be able to unlock every clip through a recurring monthly plan or buy single videos outright; both options need to coexist cleanly in the storefront and catalogue.
Each model will have a personal creator account to upload, tag, price and manage their own videos. The system then pays them a configurable percentage of every sale, tracked automatically, with clear earnings reports they can export. I only step in as the site admin to set the global revenue split, handle support tickets and, if necessary, approve or remove content.
CCBill is the required payment gateway for all recurring subscriptions, single-item purchases and model payouts, so the build has to meet CCBill compliance standards from day one. Beyond that, I’m flexible on tech stack—whether you prefer WordPress with specialised plugins, a Laravel or Node back-end, or another secure framework—so long as it scales, runs smoothly on mobile and desktop, and keeps uploaded files secure.
Key deliverables • Fully responsive website with member, model and admin roles configured • Dual access system: monthly subscription unlocking all videos + individual video purchase/ download flow • Seamless CCBill integration for both revenue streams and automated model payout tracking • Model dashboard: upload interface, pricing controls, sales analytics, payout history • Admin dashboard: user moderation, content oversight, adjustable revenue-share percentage, manual override tools • Basic SEO setup, analytics hooks and documentation for ongoing maintenance
If you’ve built creator marketplaces or handled CCBill integrations before, let’s talk timelines and a sensible milestone plan so I can get this platform live without cutting corners on security or user experience.
